scope: Qwen4Exp c1 raw-Q4 selected dual gate/up plus BF16-boundary SiLU/product
change: Extend the registered raw selected dual gate/up owner with the exact standalone SiLU/product boundary. Each projection is rounded to BF16 bits, converted back to F32, then evaluates gate * sigmoid(gate) * up and rounds the result to BF16 in the same output workgroup. Registry misses retain dual+standalone or singleton+standalone chains.
